summary: Completed comprehensive testing of User Invitation System. All 23 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all critical elements working correctly: Invite User button, invite modal with email/role/instance fields, invite accept page with form validation, invalid token error handling, and success flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - invitation system follows best practices with token-based authentication
Email is properly lowercased on backend to prevent case-sensitivity issues
Invite tokens are 48-byte URL-safe random strings with 7-day expiry
Pre-verified users skip email verification flow correctly
Instance assignment during invite works correctly
Role toggle (promote/demote) functionality works as expected
seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_ prefix during testing, cleaned up by test fixtures
context_for_next_testing_agent: User invitation system fully tested. Key endpoints: POST /api/admin/users/invite (creates invite), GET /api/invite/{token} (public - returns invite details), POST /api/invite/{token}/accept (public - creates user account), DELETE /api/admin/users/invitations/{token} (revokes invite). Frontend pages: /admin/users (Users page with Invite User button), /invite/:token (public invite accept page). Note: Non-admin users without instance assignment get 403 on login - this is expected behavior. Test users created during testing have TEST_ prefix.

features_tested.feature: POST /api/admin/users/invite sends invitation and returns success with token
features_tested.details: Returns {success: true, message: 'Invitation sent to...', token: '...'}
Returns 400 when role is not 'superadmin' or 'user'
User is assigned to instance on invite accept

features_tested.feature: GET /api/invite/{token} returns invite details for valid pending invite
POST /api/invite/{token}/accept creates pre-verified user with correct role
features_tested.details: User can login immediately after accept

features_tested.feature: POST /api/invite/{token}/accept with already-used token returns error
Frontend Users page shows 'Invite User' button
Frontend invite modal has email, role, and instance fields
features_tested.details: All form elements with correct data-testid attributes
Email (read-only), username, password, confirm password fields present
Error card with 'Invitation not found' message displayed

features_tested.feature: Admin can promote users to Admin via role toggle

note: Resend API key is configured and working. Invitation emails are sent via Resend. Test users created during testing have TEST_ prefix and are cleaned up by test fixtures.
